home.noStudies: No studies yet. Ask a business question or start from a template above.

library.title: Persona library

persona.noEvidence: No sources were recorded for this persona; it is inferred. Use its answers with care.

scenario.brandPrompt: Research how [target audience] perceive [brand] and which positioning would fit better.
scenario.competitorPrompt: Research why users choose [competitor] and why they leave. Where are our differentiation opportunities?
scenario.conceptPrompt: Test this product concept: [one-line description]. Find out whether target users want it and what concerns them.
scenario.consumerPrompt: I want to understand the real needs and pain points of [target audience] in [scenario]. Run a consumer insight study for me.
scenario.contentPrompt: Research what content [target audience] like and where they get information, then suggest a content strategy.
scenario.productPrompt: We plan to build [product direction]. Research the target users' needs and propose a few product concepts worth validating.

state.fileLoadFailed: Could not read the file. Please try again later.

study.notFound: This study was not found. It may have been deleted.

churn.description: Find out why first-time buyers never come back
churn.prompt: Our 90-day repurchase rate for first-time buyers is low. Research why they do not come back, which segments churn most, and what we can improve.
churn.title: First-purchase churn

conceptTest.description: Hear from target users before launch
conceptTest.prompt: We are about to launch: [one-line description]. Run a concept test: are target users interested, what are their biggest concerns, and how much would they pay?
conceptTest.title: New product concept test

import.description: Upload interviews, surveys or customer data to generate your own personas
import.prompt: I uploaded user materials (interview notes / surveys / customer data). Build AI personas from them, save them to the persona library, and summarize each persona's key traits.
import.title: Build personas from my data

pricing.description: What different segments would pay for, and how much
pricing.prompt: Research pricing for [product]: willingness to pay by segment, price sensitivities and a recommended pricing plan.
pricing.title: Pricing and willingness to pay

segment.description: Find differentiation through communities and JTBD
segment.prompt: As a small team we want to build [product direction]. Using community and Jobs-to-be-Done lenses, find the segments and opportunities most worth entering.
segment.title: Niche segment opportunities
